strengths_deep_dive: Ta'leef Collective fills a niche space within the American Muslim community by offering structured convert care, religious education, and direct assistance [4]. In 2023, the charity documented consistent engagement, serving <cite id="4">1,300 weekly beneficiaries across events and media</cite> and supporting <cite id="4">101 individuals in their shahadas</cite>. Additionally, the organization directly distributed <cite id="4">$280,000 in zakat</cite> to assist community members [1], [4].
rich_narrative.summary: Ta'leef Collective provides religious education and convert care support, but faces significant financial efficiency challenges. Founded in <cite id="4">2005</cite>, the organization offers classes, youth programs, and re-entry services [4]. In FY2024, the charity reported <cite id="3">$1,371,252 in total revenue</cite>. However, financial figures show a severe efficiency concern. In FY2024, the organization operated with a <cite id="2">program expense ratio of 18.9%</cite>. This falls well below the 75% sector benchmark, indicating that the vast majority of spending goes toward non-program costs. Overall, <cite id="2">Charity Navigator gives the organization a 40/100 rating</cite>. Despite these financial constraints, Ta'leef Collective maintains an active religious program. In 2023, the organization reached <cite id="4">1,300 weekly beneficiaries across events and media</cite>, facilitated <cite id="4">101 shahadas</cite>, and disbursed <cite id="1">$280,000 in zakat funds</cite>.
